Iran Vows Revenge for Leader's Killing; US Threatens Attack

Following the funeral of Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, his successor Mojtaba Khamenei vowed revenge for his father's death, stating Iran had a list of targets. Concurrently, US President Donald Trump issued threats of an attack on Iran. Reports also indicate Israel warned the US of a new Iranian plot to assassinate Trump amid escalating tensions.
